description: This Java class 'BomBuilder' generates BOM (Bill of Materials) CSV files from component and PCB data, with options for customizing output details and handling component ignore list.

classes.name: BomBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building BOM CSV files from component and PCB data, with configurable options and dictionary handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads input files, and generates BOM lists.

methods.name: writeMissingElements
methods.description: Removes components without BOM records and logs missing entries.

methods.name: writeFullPartList
methods.description: Generates a detailed full BOM CSV file.

methods.name: findModule
methods.description: Checks if a component reference exists in the PCB modules.

methods.name: writeCompactPartList
methods.description: Generates a compact BOM CSV file.

methods.name: writeCommonHeader
methods.description: Writes header information to BOM CSV files.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a BOM line entry to CSV.

methods.name: readBomDictionary
methods.description: Parses BOM dictionary CSV data into a map.
